_about: Programs that serve a place but aren't separate nonprofits, or aren't in IRS filings as such (Oct 29 2026, Inglewood reports for Keith). Researched by hand from public web pages. Each entry: what it is, who runs it, whether it serves the place (confirmed only with a quote from the source), the evidence URL and the date it was read. No guessing: weak evidence is 'not confirmed'. Shown by the search report (app/report) for the matching place and topic.

dental.name: Inglewood Clinic Group
dental.operator: UCLA School of Dentistry students (UCLA Community Programs Office)
dental.kind: Student-run free and low-cost dental care
dental.evidence: Children and adults of the underserved populations within Inglewood and Westwood.
dental.detail: Partner location: The Children's Dental Center of Greater Los Angeles (300 E. Buckthorn St., Inglewood). Exams, fluoride varnish, sealants, fillings, crowns and extractions.

dental.name: The Children's Dental Center, Community Outreach Program
dental.operator: The Children's Dental Center of Greater Los Angeles (a nonprofit, EIN 95-4533883)
dental.kind: School and community dental screenings and education
dental.evidence: Its programs page says the outreach program brings oral health education and screenings to children where they live and attend school, and that it was suspended in 2020 due to pandemic restrictions.
dental.detail: The center's clinic in Inglewood is open. Whether school outreach has restarted is not stated.
dental.schedule: Suspended as of 2020 per its site

dental.name: USC Mobile Dental Clinics
dental.operator: USC Herman Ostrow School of Dentistry
dental.evidence: Serves 15 local elementary schools (USC partner schools) and, with QueensCare, low-income children in grades 2 to 5 in Hollywood-area elementary schools. Inglewood is not named.
dental.detail: Twelve mobile clinics in rotation across Central and Southern California.

dental.name: QueensCare Mobile Dental Program
dental.kind: Mobile dental vans at elementary schools
dental.evidence: Visits qualifying Los Angeles Unified elementary schools. Inglewood schools are in Inglewood Unified, a separate district, and are not named.
dental.detail: Four vans with three chairs each, rotating among schools where most students qualify for free lunch.

dental.name: Venice Family Clinic, Inglewood Health Center
dental.operator: Venice Family Clinic (South Bay Family Health Care)
dental.kind: Community health center, 1091 S. La Brea Ave., Inglewood
dental.evidence: Its dental care page lists dental only at Culver City (4700 Inglewood Blvd.), Santa Monica and Redondo Beach. No dental location in Inglewood.
dental.detail: The Culver City dental site is the nearest Venice Family Clinic dental location to Inglewood.

dental.name: LA County Oral Health Program, priority schools
dental.operator: Los Angeles County Department of Public Health
dental.kind: School screenings, fluoride varnish and referrals
dental.evidence: The county lists priority elementary schools (October 2021), but the list could not be read to confirm Inglewood schools.

dental.name: St. John's Community Health and Watts Healthcare
dental.operator: Federally qualified health centers in South LA
dental.kind: Clinic dental care, school wellness centers
dental.evidence: St. John's runs dental care at its South LA clinics and a school wellness center in Compton. No Inglewood dental site or van was found for either.
